Who We Are

Pioneering Veterinary Diagnostics in Bengaluru

Rohana Veterinary Diagnostic Lab (RVD) is Bengaluru's first lab with state-of-the-art veterinary diagnostic technology, exclusively catering to veterinary clinics, breeders, national institutes and animal shelters.

We offer quality diagnostic services including hemogram, serum biochemistry, immunology, bacteriology, serology, virology, histopathology, parasitology, molecular diagnostics and toxicology for all animal species.

All tests follow strict Standard Operating Procedures in a 2400 sqft facility with separate rooms for analytical, toxicology and microbiology services.
